t: You're looking at The Neighbours, a sculpture on the Quadrant Estate in Islington, near Clissold Park. It was commissioned in 1957 using money London County Council had set aside for public art in its housing projects, and unveiled in 1959. It has been Grade II listed since April 1998. The sculptor, Siegfried Charoux, mainly worked as a figurative sculptor in bronze, stone or terracotta. Born in Austria, he moved to England in 1935 and became a British citizen in 1946.
